Jeong Han Kim and BaoLinh Tran

## Abstract

Majority dynamics is a process on a simple; undirected graph G with an initial Red/Blue color for every vertex of G. ## Introduction

## 1.l Majority Dynamics

Consider a parliamentary election with two parties. The election season begins with each voter supports one side. At the end of every each voter polls their friends; then supports the majority side the next morning; or keeps their affiliation in case of a tie. On election everyone votes for the party they currently supports and the parliament  will be divided proportionally with each side's number of votes\_ Day day; day,

This process can be modeled with a process; where vertices represent voters and edges represent friendships. We let Red and Blue; Or R and B, stand for the two parties.
